correctness.rationale: For a>b>0, q>=0 and rotated A, the one-column projected squared Frobenius residual is b²+(a²-b²)β²(1-t)/(α²t+β²(1-t)) with α=a^(2q+1), β=b^(2q+1), t leading eigenbasis squared direction. Uniform Gaussian angle integrates to b²+(a²-b²)β/(α+β). The two independent-sign projective directions have t=(1±sin2θ)/2, averaging to the claimed rational Bq(T). Direct differentiation in T gives positive numerator 2α²β²DS over positive squared denominator. Equating risks gives Tc=(1+r²)/(1+r)², strictly 1/2<Tc<1. The resonant π/4 sign vector annihilates the leading eigendirection half the time, giving Bq=(a²+b²)/2 at every q. The angular half-width δq=½arcsin(√(2r)/(1+r)) obeys δq~(b/a)^(q+1/2)/√2; off-resonance Bq→b². Independent rational matrix multiplication and enumeration verified 48 exact instances, finite checks not universal proof.
